key_insight: OAT3D generates high-resolution 3D structural topologies using a generative model designed to accommodate varying domain shapes, resolutions, loads, and supports.
engineering_relevance: It accelerates structural topology optimization, reporting a 3.65× speedup over conventional optimization when targeting similar compliance.
method: Sparsely encode load and fixity conditions.
Represent structures with a sparse volumetric variational autoencoder.
Generate candidate topologies using a conditional diffusion transformer.
evidence_signal: Training data comprise 501,865 optimized topologies generated using 51,800 GPU-hours; OAT3D generates structures at 512³ resolution with a reported 44.9× speedup for raw candidate generation.
watch_item: Raw generation speed does not imply equivalent structural performance; generated candidates still warrant finite element verification.
paper_title: OAT3D: A Generative Model for 3D Shape- and Resolution-Free Structural Topology Optimization
